from circuits import prepare_state
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Operator

ref = QuantumCircuit(2)
ref.h(0)
ref.cx(0, 1)
ref.rz(0.5, 0)

qc = prepare_state()
assert Operator(qc).equiv(Operator(ref)), 'the circuit no longer computes the same unitary'

ops = qc.count_ops()
assert ops.get('cx', 0) <= 1, f"expected at most 1 CNOT, got {ops.get('cx', 0)}"
assert ops.get('x', 0) == 0, f"the cancelling X pair should be gone, got {ops.get('x', 0)}"
